title: filix-mas squamigera
intro: Filix-mas squamigera, commonly known as the Rough Horsetail, is a species of vascular plant in the family Equisetaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and other kidney-related issues due to its diuretic properties. The Rough Horsetail's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate kidney function, reduce inflammation, and promote the elimination of waste products from the body. The bioactive constituents of Filix-mas squamigera include silicic acid, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
